description: Disponibilità Parcheggi (VIGENTE) is a dataset listed in Comune di Bologna open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna - Innovazione Digitale e Dati. Disponibilità parcheggi pubblici a Bologna, orario vigente. Le rilevazioni vengono effettuate ogni 10 minuti. Viene segnalata solo l'ultima rilevazione. Lo storico delle rilevazioni è disponibile al seguente dataset. Coverage: Bologna. The portal files it under Trasporti, Governo e settore pubblico. The portal shows 3 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-comune-bologna-it-portal.
